basis: Independent read-only review of current first-party official pages, separate from the model outputs. Core user-requested issues are required; optional procedural detail is not an exhaustive pass/fail checklist.

accounting-accrual.core: Explain activity/recognition timing versus cash movements and the unpaid supplier liability without inventing amounts or statutory duties.

accounting-asset-register.core: Explain the detailed fixed asset register versus general ledger balances and their reconciliation; retain the qualified accounting instructions without a statutory-registration detour.

iras-private-car.core: Business use alone does not remove the private motor car input-GST restriction. Address the restriction and keep exceptions conditional on relevant facts, without asserting all exceptions have been ruled out.

cpf-employer-responsibility.core: Employer remits the applicable employer and employee shares, with employee share recoverable from wages where applicable. Collect relevant age, contribution period, remuneration and OW/AW facts without inventing rates or amounts; respect the supplied citizenship/contract facts.

mom-salary-overtime.core: State different deadlines: ordinary salary within seven days and overtime within fourteen days after the salary period ends; offer useful payroll steps with official support. Coverage is already supplied.

acra-sole-director-secretary.core: Directly state the sole director cannot also be company secretary. Explain appointing a different eligible local-resident natural person and the relevant appointment/filing steps; qualify private-company versus public-company requirements.
acra-sole-director-secretary.relevantProceduralDetails: Appointment within six months; officer updates within fourteen days. Verify any additional procedure asserted by a generated answer against the applicable official page.

mas-fund-management-startup.core: Explain fund-management regulatory perimeter and the need to establish the applicable CMS licensing route or a specific exemption before regulated activity. Ask relevant activity, asset/product, discretion, mandate, investor/relationship and Singapore-operation facts. Do not treat small scale or accredited investors alone as an exemption.

mixed-first-employee.core: Cover both CPF setup/contribution remittance and MOM salary duties. Request material citizenship/PR, age, employment/pay and coverage facts without assuming every employee attracts CPF or overtime. Distinguish CPF payment dates from MOM salary dates if stated.

limitations: Not an exhaustive review of statutory instruments or every fact-specific exemption.
A safe refusal or generic authority referral does not establish a useful complete answer.
Any generated claim beyond this rubric requires its own source verification.
